question: What is the pettiest revenge you have ever pulled off?
story: My neighbor kept stealing my packages, so I mailed myself a box of glitter rigged to explode. For three months my deliveries vanished the second they hit my porch. The camera caught him every time, but the police said a blurry hoodie was not enough. So I got creative. I ordered a plain brown box, filled it with a spring-loaded glitter bomb, and added a fake shipping label for a two hundred dollar phone. Then I waited. Twenty minutes after the truck left, he strolled over and grabbed it. That night I heard a scream through the wall so loud my dog barked. The next morning his car, his driveway, and his welcome mat sparkled like a disco ball. He never touched my mail again. To this day I still find glitter on his porch. Justice is shiny.
